Opportunities

Senior Mechanical Engineer /
Mechanical Engineer

Worldwide

Design and develop next-generation networking products, working with cross-functional teams from concept to mass production.

Senior Mechanical Engineer /
Mechanical Engineer

Worldwide

Responsibilities

  • Design and development of next-generation, cloud-centric networking products from concept to mass production
  • Work with cross-functional teams to implement various technologies, including Wi-Fi, BLE, Cellular, GPS, and more
  • Drive solutions for cross-functional issues, including those related to architecture (performance, thermal, mechanical, cosmetic, etc.) and development

Requirements

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering
  • Experience in mechanical and industrial design of electronic products
  • Good knowledge of material properties, characteristics, and mechanical processes
  • Experience in RF and networking products is a plus
  • Experience in marine or power supply products is an advantage
  • Work with electronics and production engineers in DFM
  • Experience in problem-solving for mechanical, cosmetic, and thermal issues
  • 3–7 years of working experience
  • Work closely with project managers on task prioritization and meeting project deadlines
  • Self-motivated, well-organized, with strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

Senior Electronics Engineer /
Hardware Engineer

Worldwide

Design and optimize electronic systems for Peplink’s networking products, from circuit design to system integration.

Senior Electronics Engineer /
Hardware Engineer

Worldwide

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop next-generation, cloud-centric networking products from concept to mass production
  • Work with cross-functional teams to implement various technologies, including Wi-Fi, BLE, Cellular, GPS, and more
  • Drive solutions for cross-functional issues related to architecture (performance, power consumption, thermal behavior) and development (schematic design, PCB layout, and overall system integration)

Requirements

  • Degree in Electronics Engineering
  • Experience in electronic/electrical design of electronic products
  • Good knowledge of electronic and electrical components, their properties, and characteristics
  • Familiarity with industry certification requirements and compliance (FCC, CE-RED, safety, etc.)
  • Experience in troubleshooting EMI/EMC, functional, safety, and thermal issues
  • Proficiency in schematic and PCB layout design
  • Experience in marine or power supply products is an advantage
  • Experience in rechargeable batteries, RF, power electronics, impedance matching, and antenna design is a plus
  • Work with mechanical and production engineers in DFM
  • Collaborate with software engineers to realize product functions and improve performance
  • Work closely with project managers on task prioritization and meeting project deadlines
  • Minimum 5 years of working experience
  • Self-motivated and well-organized, with strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

Software Engineer (C/C++)
(Senior / Fresh grad welcome)

Worldwide

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain software to enhance Peplink’s ecosystem.

Project Manager /
Project Engineer

Worldwide

Lead product development and manufacturing projects, ensuring quality, cost, and delivery goals are met.

Project Manager /
Project Engineer

Worldwide

Responsibilities

  • Own, lead, monitor, and report on projects for high-end network products from ES to MP stages, managed through contract manufacturers (CMs)
  • Ensure project milestones and deliverables from CMs are achieved on time and meet all requirements and specifications
  • Work with CMs throughout all stages, from quotation to sample and product delivery
  • Coordinate functional teams, both in-house and within CMs, to support project activities and ensure all documentation (drawings, BOMs, agreements, etc.) is accurate and up to date
  • Ensure Engineering Change Notices (ECNs) are properly implemented and monitored
  • As a key member of the operations team, assume R&D’s responsibilities when products transition from development to PP/MP stages
  • Provide and verify production-related information to support production planning
  • Report issues promptly and drive effective solutions
  • Review CM performance and promote improvements in quality, cost, efficiency, and problem-solving
  • Act as the liaison between the company and CMs
  • Oversee CM activities (in collaboration with PE, Purchaser, QE, etc.), including line setup, material preparation, assembly, testing, and packaging according to SOPs

Requirements

  • Degree in an Engineering discipline; Electronics Engineering preferred
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in project management, preferably in the EMS/electronics manufacturing industry or product development
  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail
  • Well-organized with a proactive approach to problem-solving
  • Able and willing to work in a multitasking environment, under pressure, and with minimal supervision
  • Good command of written and spoken English and Chinese (Mandarin)
  • Proficient in MS PowerPoint, Word, and Excel
  • Strong business, cost, and quality awareness
  • Knowledge of networking and/or RF products is an advantage
  • Candidates with less experience will be considered for the Project Engineer role
